manualReview.scope: Model/editor Product Quality v2 naturalness polish of EN-A1-L-0071; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Character prompts and English distractors were re-read as complete learner-facing utterances; teacher directives and known ungrammatical generated distractors were removed.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: The Persian phrasing conveys belonging to oneself rather than the verb own.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson keeps own after a possessive and avoids claiming unrelated senses.

distractorQuality.evidence: Wrong English options are grammatical/natural alternatives that differ on meaning, action, referent, quantity, polarity or context instead of using broken substitutions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Character turns now ask or react in ways that pragmatically license the learner response rather than instructing the learner to repeat a line.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short, reuse established A1 language, and add only the bounded target planned for this Lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The neighbors arc returns seven Lessons after 0064 and is separated from the immediately previous library scene.

transferQuality.evidence: The transfer changes demonstrative and possessor while preserving the own pattern.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities, retrieval task, and stated outcome all point to the same bounded learning goal.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; engagement and perceived difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
